Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the GNLU Senior Clerk recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the GNLU Senior Clerk position is 07 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Clerk post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's or Bachelor's degree in any discipline from a recognized university. Relevant work experience is also a requirement.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Senior Clerk position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Clerk post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Clerk role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 26,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the GNLU Senior Clerk job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. Ensure you follow the instructions provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Senior Clerk position?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Senior Clerk post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Senior Clerk position at GNLU.

faq.question: Q9. Where is GNLU located?
faq.answer: Gujarat National Law University (GNLU) is located in Gandhinagar, Gujarat, with the pincode 382426.

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Senior Clerk position at GNLU.
